Context: (e) For purchase of plot and construction of house.-

- (iii) The property mortgaged on behalf of President of India, shall be reconveyed on the prescribed form to the Central Government employee concerned (or their successors in interest, as the case may be), after the advance together with interest thereon, has been repaid to Government in full and after obtaining No Demand Certificate in respect  
- of HBA loan sanctioned by the 2nd loan sanctioning authority. - Rule 9.
